name: read_style_guide
description: Read the style guide document for a run. Returns the complete style guide content. By default reads the current run's style guide; pass runId to read another run's style guide. A run that has not written a style guide returns an unavailable result, and a stored style guide too large to deliver whole returns an unavailable error explaining how to resolve it.

detailed: Reads a run's style guide document.
tool {participantRole} is reading the style guide

runId.description: Optional run id (run-YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS) whose style guide to read. Omit it to read the current run's style guide.
